001package org.clafer.instance;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.math.BigDecimal;
005import java.util.ArrayList;
006import java.util.Arrays;
007import java.util.List;
008import java.util.Objects;
009import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
010import org.clafer.ast.AstConcreteClafer;
011import org.clafer.cli.Utils;
012import org.clafer.common.Check;
013
014/**
015 *
016 * @author jimmy
017 */
018public class InstanceClafer {
019
020    private final AstClafer type;
021    private final int id;
022    private final Object ref;
023    private final InstanceClafer[] children;
024
025    public InstanceClafer(AstClafer type, int id, Object ref, InstanceClafer... children) {
026        this.type = Check.notNull(type);
027        this.id = id;
028        this.ref = ref;
029        this.children = Check.noNulls(children);
030    }
031
032    public AstClafer getType() {
033        return type;
034    }
035
036    public int getId() {
037        return id;
038    }
039
040    public boolean hasRef() {
041        return ref != null;
042    }
043
044    public Object getRef() {
045        return ref;
046    }
047
048    public boolean hasChildren() {
049        return children.length != 0;
050    }
051
052    public InstanceClafer[] getChildren() {
053        return children;
054    }
055
056    public InstanceClafer[] getChildren(AstConcreteClafer type) {
057        List<InstanceClafer> typedChildren = new ArrayList<>();
058        for (InstanceClafer child : children) {
059            if (type.equals(child.getType())) {
060                typedChildren.add(child);
061            }
062        }
063        return typedChildren.toArray(new InstanceClafer[typedChildren.size()]);
064    }
065
066    public InstanceClafer getChild(AstConcreteClafer type) {
067        InstanceClafer typedChild = null;
068        for (InstanceClafer child : children) {
069            if (type.equals(child.getType())) {
070                if (typedChild != null) {
071                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("More than one child Clafer with type " + type);
072                }
073                typedChild = child;
074            }
075        }
076        if (typedChild == null) {
077            throw new IllegalArgumentException("No child Clafer with type " + type);
078        }
079        return typedChild;
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * Print solution to stdout.
084     *
085     * @throws IOException an IO error occurred
086     */
087    public void print() throws IOException {
088        print(System.out);
089    }
090
091    /**
092     * Print solution.
093     *
094     * @param out the stream to print to
095     * @throws IOException an IO error occurred
096     */
097    public void print(Appendable out) throws IOException {
098        print(out, false);
099    }
100
101    /**
102     * Print solution.
103     *
104     * @param out the stream to print to
105     * @param addTypes whether to print the super clafer of each clafer
106     * @throws IOException an IO error occurred
107     */
108    public void print(Appendable out, boolean addTypes) throws IOException {
109        print("", out, addTypes);
110    }
111
112    private void print(String indent, Appendable out, boolean addTypes) throws IOException {
113        out.append(indent).append(getType().getName()).append(Utils.countSuffix(getId()));
114        if (addTypes && getType().hasSuperClafer()) {
115            String superName = getType().getSuperClafer().getName();
116            // do not print the default super type "clafer"
117            if (!superName.equals("#clafer#")) {
118                out.append(" : ").append(superName);
119            }
120        }
121        if (hasRef()) {
122            out.append(" -> ");
123            if (getRef() instanceof InstanceClafer) {
124                InstanceClafer refClafer = (InstanceClafer) getRef();
125                out.append(refClafer.getType().getName()).append(Utils.countSuffix(refClafer.getId()));
126            } else if (getRef() instanceof BigDecimal) {
127                // Never scientific notation, e.g. 0.0000001 rather than 1E-7.
128                out.append(((BigDecimal) getRef()).toPlainString());
129            } else {
130                out.append(getRef().toString());
131            }
132        }
133        out.append('\n');
134        for (InstanceClafer child : getChildren()) {
135            child.print(indent + "  ", out, addTypes);
136        }
137    }
138
139    @Override
140    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
141        if (obj instanceof InstanceClafer) {
142            InstanceClafer other = (InstanceClafer) obj;
143            return type.equals(other.type) && id == other.id
144                    && Objects.equals(ref, other.ref) && Arrays.equals(children, other.children);
145        }
146        return false;
147    }
148
149    @Override
150    public int hashCode() {
151        return type.hashCode() ^ id ^ Objects.hashCode(ref) ^ Arrays.hashCode(children);
152    }
153
154    @Override
155    public String toString() {
156        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
157        try {
158            print(result);
159        } catch (IOException e) {
160            // StringBuilder should not throw an IOException.
161            throw new Error(e);
162        }
163        return result.toString();
164    }
165}
